description: React component for managing and displaying team information, including team list, team details, filters, modals for creating/deleting teams, and role-based UI elements.

classes.name: TeamsView
classes.description: React functional component for team management UI, including state management, data fetching, and rendering team list and details.

methods.name: handleOk
methods.description: Handles closing the team creation/edit modal, resets form and related states.

methods.name: handleMemberOk
methods.description: Handles closing the add/edit member modal, resets form.

methods.name: handleCancel
methods.description: Handles canceling the team modal, resets form and states.

methods.name: handleDelete
methods.description: Prepares to delete a team by setting state and opening confirmation modal.

methods.name: confirmDelete
methods.description: Confirms team deletion, calls API, updates team list, handles errors.

methods.name: cancelDelete
methods.description: Cancels team deletion process, resets delete modal state.

methods.name: is_team_admin
methods.description: Checks if current user is admin of a given team.

methods.name: handleFilterChange
methods.description: Updates filters and fetches filtered team list.

methods.name: handleSortChange
methods.description: Updates sorting options and fetches sorted team list.

methods.name: handleFilterReset
methods.description: Resets filters to default and fetches full team list.
